source.author: R. B. Robinson and C. Driver
source.note: UNT Digital Library copy: a different scan from the NTRS file (28 pages, 1-bit images). Used only as an independent check of the NTRS digitization. Its grid calibration below is NOT usable: in this 1-bit scan the fine, medium and heavy rulings all print black, and the picked intersections land on the wrong lines (affine residuals up to 17 px); its data values must not be used. Only the ring centres in pixels are used, by tools/digitize/scan_check.py.
source.declared_accuracy_source: RM L51K16a, PDF p. 6 (printed 5): estimated errors in the force data CL +/-0.005, CD +/-0.001, Cm +/-0.001; wing angle of attack +/-0.1 deg

figure.title: Aerodynamic characteristics in pitch of the various wing-body configurations. (c) Lambda = 47 deg; t/c = 0.04. Middle plot: drag coefficient.
figure.x_axis: Lift coefficient, CL (one axis, -0.2 to 0.8, common to the three plots of the panel)
figure.y_axis: Drag coefficient, CD (scale on the right, 0 to 0.20)
figure.content_note: Configuration 47deg-t04 at M 1.60, one polar. Measured points: hollow circles without a centre dot, joined by a faired curve, on fine-ruled graph paper (lines every 0.005 in CL and 0.002 in CD, heavier every 0.05 and 0.02).

scan.extraction: tools/digitize/extract_scan.py on the UNT PDF: the page's single embedded 1-bit image, upright

digitizer: main session, one reading of the UNT scan (check only, not a pass)

calibration.x_definition: Only the heavier printed lines: every 0.05 in CL from -0.2 (left frame) to 0.8, and every 0.02 in CD from 0 to 0.20 (the labelled range of the drag scale). The finer ruling (0.005 and 0.002) is not used.
